_doc: The open path (0,0) -> (30,30) -> (60,0) has a CORNER at (30,30): two straight segments meet there. A drag from it to (50,30) converts it to a smooth anchor (ANCHOR_POINT_TOOLS.md, press-time priority 3): the out-handle sits at the release point (50,30), and the in-handle is mirrored through the anchor to (10,30). Both segments become curves.
name: anchor_point_drag_corner_to_smooth
